goal: Build FeralOS — a new Linux distribution based on Alpine, focused on memory safety and security
active_goals: Rewrite btrfsStandard for LUKS + booster + UKI (Phase 1)

decisions.decision: FeralOS is a new distribution, not just an installer
decisions.rationale: Goal is a complete distro with memory safety focus, Dinit, custom repos
Installer logic never changes, only data (YAML + Go layouts) changes
Non-negotiable core must always be present
Easier to maintain than YAML, still modular

decisions.decision: Generator can run standalone or integrated
decisions.rationale: Supports both interactive and unattended modes

decisions.decision: Use Nix for glibc and alternative software
decisions.rationale: Access Nixpkgs without polluting base Alpine system

decisions.decision: Dinit will replace OpenRC in Phase 2
decisions.rationale: Better dependency handling, parallel startup, modern init
FeralOS-specific packages not upstream in Alpine
Useful for debugging and verifying Go implementation

decisions.decision: Use booster instead of mkinitfs for initramfs
decisions.rationale: booster is faster, simpler, and supports LUKS2 natively

decisions.decision: Use signed UKI instead of GRUB
decisions.rationale: Unified Kernel Image enables Secure Boot without GRUB complexity

decisions.decision: LUKS encryption on RAID and Swap partitions
decisions.rationale: Full disk encryption for security, matching reference installer
Btrfs native RAID1 is simpler and more reliable than mdadm
These are standard components used by all disk layouts

decisions.decision: If a module has chroot commands, entire module goes in chrootPhase
decisions.rationale: Don't split modules across hostPhase/chrootPhase - keep related code together
packages.go, services.go, users.go, dmcrypt.go, hardening.go, uki.go, zswap.go for easier review

decisions.decision: zswap is a separate module with enableZswap toggle
decisions.rationale: No disk dependencies, pure memory optimization, toggleable via config
Show command execution and results (stdout/stderr) in debug mode

risks.risk: NVMe disk naming varies across hardware
risks.mitigation: Use blockdev for size detection, fdisk for partitioning
Validate hook files exist, log execution output

risks.risk: Nix integration may conflict with APK
risks.mitigation: Use separate /nix prefix, avoid PATH conflicts

risks.risk: Dinit migration may break existing services
risks.mitigation: Phase 2 only, after installer is stable

risks.risk: LUKS password handling must be secure
risks.mitigation: Use stdin pipe to cryptsetup, never log passwords
Pin booster version in APK add
Debug kernel cmdline, booster initramfs, and UKI generation

next_actions: Debug boot failure (kernel cmdline, booster initramfs, UKI generation)
Test installer on real hardware with 2x NVMe
